The `## Acceptance criteria` section would read as follows. This is the proposed text only; nothing has been written to the spec yet.

```markdown
## Acceptance criteria

Drafted from the design, no ticket rows:

- [ ] The importer rejects an import whose ID is empty, contains only spaces, or contains a slash, and reports the same invalid-ID error in all three cases.
  in-scope
```

- **Why one row:** the design commits to a single constraint, ID validation. The three malformed forms are scenarios of that one constraint, so they share a row rather than becoming three outcomes. The shared error is part of the same observation.
- **Disposition:** `in-scope` is the default. No cut question came up, so the row has no `deviates:` or `deferred:` disposition.
- **Header:** there is no ticket, so the section uses the drafted header `Drafted from the design, no ticket rows:`.
- **Other sections:** there are no integration steps, so there is no `## Integration` section.

Stopped here, before writing the spec.
